GAZETTE UPDATE
1) Fixed. The paper now lands by 6am every morning and the 8am post goes out on time. No more lunchtime editions.
2) Tonight now updates every 30 minutes during games, 7:05pm to 1:35am: live scores, flipped categories, and whoever is embarrassing himself in real time.
3) The Week 2 Sunday Paper is live: a black-tie gala, a cable car chase, and one team that beat nobody in the building.
Read it: goongazette.com/wrap.html#2
